user.title: Energy cost compare
user.description: Pick the energy counters to record. Several counters per field are added up.

data_description.grid_import: Energy taken from the grid (kWh counters)
data_description.inv_in: AC energy into the battery inverters, from both AC-in and AC-out
data_description.inv_out: AC energy out of the battery inverters, to both AC-out and AC-in
data_description.dc_charge: Optional, used to split battery losses from stored energy
data_description.heat: Heat delivered for heating and hot water (kWh counters), for the gas comparison
data_description.hp_elec: Electricity used by the heat pump
data_description.boiler_efficiency: Efficiency of the gas boiler you compare with (0.90 = 90%, on upper heating value)
data_description.price_sensor: Day-ahead (EPEX) price in EUR/kWh, for example from ENTSO-e
data_description.price_includes_vat: On when the sensor shows the market price plus 21% VAT

error.inverter_pair: Fill in both inverter fields, or neither
error.invalid_prices: These prices can't be saved; check the values

abort.already_configured: Energy cost compare is already set up
